people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

translations.web: Your neck is like David’s tower built for an armory, on which a thousand shields hang, all the shields of the mighty men.
translations.bsb: Your neck is like the tower of David, built with rows of stones; on it hang a thousand shields, all of them shields of warriors.
translations.kjv: Thy neck is like the tower of David builded for an armoury, whereon there hang a thousand bucklers, all shields of mighty men.
translations.asv: Thy neck is like the tower of David builded for an armory, Whereon there hang a thousand bucklers, All the shields of the mighty men.
